Custom LED cups with logo: plan lighting and production

For custom light up cups and wholesale LED cups, compare vessel shape, lighting, power and branding as one specification. Follow the LED drinkware manufacturing process to prepare the sample and assembly review.

LED customization & production ↗LED customization & production · led production ↗Custom LED ice buckets ↗LED model selection guide ↗
Can LED cups with logo share the same power and lighting?

No common configuration is assumed. State the desired lighting, activation and power preference, then review each selected model. The logo should be checked with the light on and off.

BROWSE BY CATEGORY

Glow In The Dark Cups ↗

LED cup power, switching and care

LED drinkware combines a vessel with a light module. Confirm the power source, activation method, battery access and washing limits for the selected model before bulk ordering.

How is the LED module powered?

Power, battery type and access differ by model. Confirm the configuration for the exact reference.

Can LED cups be washed?

Washing method depends on the module and sealing. Check the model-specific guidance before use.

Can I choose the LED colour?

Colour, flash pattern and activation are configured per model — confirm the options for your reference.

Review activation, power and components by LED model

Confirm activation, lighting, power, included components and cleaning for each shortlisted model. A shared battery, seal, replaceable or removable module, or included lighting unit is not assumed across the range. Review decoration positions and methods against the selected surface and artwork.

How should I specify activation and power?

Describe the venue workflow, desired effect and power preference, then ask the team to confirm the exact model configuration and instructions.

定制 Logo LED 发光杯：规划灯效与生产

批量定制 LED 发光杯时，应一起比较器型、灯效、供电和品牌装饰。可结合 LED 酒具生产流程准备样品与组装审核需求。

LED 定制与生产流程 ↗LED 定制与生产流程 · led production ↗定制 LED 冰桶 ↗LED 型号选型指南 ↗
不同 LED Logo 杯的供电和灯效一样吗？

不默认不同型号采用同样配置。请说明灯效、触发和供电偏好，并逐款核对；Logo 也需检查亮灯和熄灯外观。

按品类浏览

夜光杯 ↗

LED 杯的供电、开关与保养

LED 酒具由杯体与灯组构成。批量下单前请确认供电方式、触发方式、电池更换与清洗限制。

LED 灯组如何供电？

供电方式、电池型号与更换方式按型号不同，请确认具体参考型号的配置。

LED 杯可以水洗吗？

清洗方式取决于灯组与密封结构，请先查看对应型号的说明。

LED 灯色可以选吗？

灯色、闪烁模式和触发方式按型号配置，请确认具体型号可选范围。

LED 杯的触发、供电与组件核对

请按入选型号确认触发方式、灯效、供电、配套组件与清洁条件。不同型号不默认采用相同电池或密封结构，也不默认灯组可更换、可拆卸或随杯供应。Logo位置及可用工艺应结合具体表面和图稿审核。

如何选择触发与供电方式？

说明场地操作方式、需要的灯效及供电偏好，请团队核对具体型号的配置与使用说明。
